instruction: Install lighttpd with WebDAV and SSL support
output: sudo apt install lighttpd lighttpd-mod-webdav lighttpd-mod-openssl && sudo lighty-enable-mod webdav ssl

instruction: Configure lighttpd WebDAV SSL certificate
Check lighttpd modules loaded
Enable DAV locking in lighttpd WebDAV
Disable WebDAV XML logging in lighttpd
Set lighttpd WebDAV max size for upload
output: echo 'server.max-request-size = 102400' | sudo tee -a /etc/lighttpd/lighttpd.conf && sudo systemctl restart lighttpd

instruction: Configure Apache WebDAV with digest auth and DAVLockDB
output: sudo htdigest -c /etc/apache2/webdav-digest.passwd 'WebDAV Realm' alice && echo 'DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/DAVLock.dir' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/davlock.conf && sudo a2enconf davlock && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Create ownCloud external storage S3 bucket
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ files_external:create --mount-point /s3backup --storage-type amazon-s3 --backend s3::bucket=mybackup --config access_key=AKID --config secret_key=secret
